findings.evidence: The header delete-all button calls deleteNotifications(null) on a single click; the RPC with NULL deletes every notification of the user, including rows beyond the 30 loaded (NOTIFICATION_LIMIT) and rows inserted after the popover loaded. This matches spec section 12.1/12.2 exactly.
findings.impact: An accidental click irreversibly hard-deletes the whole inbox, including notifications the user never saw in the popover. No data integrity or security impact.
findings.recommendation: Non-blocking, spec-conformant. Decide as a product follow-up whether delete-all needs a confirmation step or should pass only the loaded IDs.

findings.evidence: complete_push_notification_delivery raises no_data_found when the notification row is gone. With R106 a user can hard-delete a notification while send-notifications holds its 5-minute claim; the Edge Function only logs the failed complete RPC (supabase/functions/send-notifications/index.ts:435).
findings.impact: For that one delivery, expired endpoint cleanup and last_success_at updates are skipped; the next push to the user retries the cleanup. The push itself may already have been delivered. No user-facing error.
findings.recommendation: Non-blocking. Optionally let the complete RPC return quietly when the row no longer exists, or accept the self-healing behavior.
